offering_description.value: Silgan sells metal cans, dispensing systems, closures and rigid plastic containers to food, beverage and other consumer goods manufacturers. It designs and manufactures packaging to customer specifications and supplies it directly to companies that fill and market the finished products.

primary_products.value: Steel and aluminum cans; dispensing pumps and sprayers; metal and plastic closures; rigid plastic bottles and jars

customer_segment.value: B2B: Food and pet food processors, beverage producers, and manufacturers of beauty, household and healthcare products

end_markets.value: Food and beverage; pet food; beauty and personal care; household products; healthcare

revenue_model.value: product sales: Cans, dispensing systems, closures and rigid plastic containers supplied under customer purchasing agreements

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Forms steel, aluminum and plastic into containers sold to food processors and consumer goods manufacturers; component supplier: Uses metal and plastic to make closures and dispensers for beverage and consumer goods manufacturers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia and South America

specialization.value: related lines: Metal containers, dispensing systems, specialty closures and custom rigid plastic containers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Direct supply relationships with food processors and other consumer goods manufacturers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: FDA and EU food-contact packaging rules, plus environmental and workplace safety requirements for manufacturing plants
